post.text:
Really weird timing for the Colts and Kenny Moore II trade. Colts have a few major needs and very few avenues to fill them by training camp. Plenty of cap space though.

So dumping another starter for what likely won’t be a big return seems odd at this moment
post.author_description: Lead Analyst @ColtsOn_SI. Co-Host of @LockedOnColts. Husband of @TheHannahHicks. Inquiries: hickszach@yahoo.com. He/Him.
